claim: San Juan de Gaztelugatxe requires a free timed ticket, bookable only for the current year via the official Tiketa platform, with an auto-cancel 60 minutes after the scheduled slot and a one-year ban for no-shows.
quote: Reservations can only be made for the current year. ... Reservations auto-cancel 60 minutes after the scheduled time if you don't arrive. ... failing to appear within the designated time prevents new reservations for one year.

claim: Entry to Gaztelugatxe is free but a ticket is mandatory at peak times (every day June 10-Sept 15, weekends April 13-June 9, plus autumn weekends/holidays), with a 1,462 person daily cap and cancellation allowed up to 2 hours before.
quote: Reservations are required every day in the peak summer season ... between June 10 and September 15 ... A limit of 1,462 persons per day has been established. You can cancel your reservation ... up to 2 hours before the date and time of the visit.

claim: The Gernika Peace Museum charges EUR 6.50 general / EUR 4.50 reduced, is free Saturday afternoons and for under-12s, runs Mon 10:00-14:30 and Tue-Sat 10:00-19:00 in high season, and suggests 1h30 for a visit.
quote: General admission: EUR 6.50 ... Free entry: Children under 12, disabled visitors, ICOM members, Saturday afternoons ... Mar 16-Oct 18: Mon 10:00-14:30; Tue-Sat 10:00-19:00; Sun 10:00-14:30 ... allowing 1 h 30 min

claim: Gernika's must-sees cluster around Plaza de los Fueros: the Casa de Juntas (Bizkaia's historic assembly, with the Tree of Gernika), the Peace Museum recreating the 1937 bombing in 3D, and the Euskal Herria museum.
quote: the Casa de Juntas, the Museo Euskal Herria ... the assembly representing Bizkaia province, used to meet, taking decisions under the Tree of Gernika ... the bombing is recreated in a 3D audiovisual and you can hear real testimony by survivors.

claim: Gernika's weekly Monday market is the most important in Bizkaia and recalls the April 26 1937 market-day bombing that destroyed nearly 90% of the town.
quote: Gernika's weekly market is the most important of those held in Bizkaia ... every Monday. ... On April 26th, 1937, which was a market day, Gernika was attacked and nearly 90% of the town was destroyed

claim: Entry to the Casa de Juntas is free, with summer hours 10:00-14:00 and 16:00-19:00 (afternoons close at 18:00 in winter); online booking is recommended at busy times.
quote: Entry to the Casa de Juntas is free but limited ... summer hours are 10:00-14:00 and 16:00-19:00, while winter hours are 10:00-14:00 and 16:00-18:00 (daily).

claim: Mundaka is a fishing village inside the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve famous for a left-hand river-mouth wave rated among the best in Europe, suited mostly to intermediate and advanced surfers.
quote: Mundaka is a tiny fishing village famous for its legendary left-hand river mouth ... some of Europe's best barrels. The waves suit mostly intermediate and advanced surfers ... inside the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve.

claim: Bermeo is a fishing town whose harbour offers fish specialities like marmitako (tuna-potato stew), and beginner surfers head to nearby Laida beach; Gaztelugatxe is the area's tenth-century hermitage islet used as Dragonstone in Game of Thrones.
quote: Bermeo is a quiet seaside town with some amazing food ... like marmitako, a fisherman's stew. ... San Juan de Gaztelugatxe features a tenth-century hermitage dedicated to St. John the Baptist on an islet ... appears in the Game of Thrones series as Dragonstone.

claim: Butron Castle in Gatika is a fairytale fortress rebuilt in 1878 by architect Francisco de Cubas on a Bavarian model, set in the Uribe region near Mungia.
quote: In 1878 the architect Francisco de Cubas, commissioned by the Marquis of Torrecilla, undertook the current reconstruction following the model of the Bavarian castles of the time, transforming Butron into a fairytale castle.

claim: As of 2024-2025 reviews, Butron Castle interior is closed for long-running restoration (scaffolded, work expected to last at least a year), so it can typically only be admired from outside.
quote: the castle is closed for work with nothing specified on the duration of the work, everything is scaffolded so no visit for long ... a reform worker stated they have a lot of time and work, at least a year.

claim: Mungia, in a sheltered valley near the coast and close to Loiu airport, offers the medieval Torrebillela tower-house (now a culture centre), the 16th-century Landetxo Goikoa farmhouse, the Gothic San Pedro church, and a Friday farmers' market (azoka).
quote: Torrebillela towerhouse, of medieval origin ... home to the culture centre. Landetxo Goikoa ... the oldest country house in Bizkaia ... On Fridays the azoka (fair in Basque) is held, where the baserritarras of the area sell ... their best products.

claim: Bilbao to Gaztelugatxe is about a 45-minute drive, with roughly 25-40 minutes between the Gaztelugatxe, Bermeo and Gernika stops; from Larrabetzu (east of Bilbao toward the coast) these times are broadly similar or shorter.
quote: From Bilbao to Gaztelugatxe takes about 45 minutes, then approximately 25-40 minutes between stops ... from Gaztelugatxe area to Bermeo is about 30 minutes, and from Bermeo to Gernika takes another 30 minutes
